title: SAT Math 7 — Nonlinear Functions Quiz
question: Five SAT-style questions on nonlinear functions, with full working.
intro: Five questions on nonlinear functions. **Show your working before you choose or type an answer.**

questions.title: Tripling every 4 hours
questions.prompt:
A bacteria culture starts with 500 cells and triples every 4 hours.

How many cells are there after 12 hours?

questions.title: Vertex and direction
questions.prompt: Which function has its vertex at \((-2, 7)\) and opens downward?

questions.title: Find the constant first
questions.prompt:
\[g(x) = 3^x + k\]

\(k\) is a constant and \(g(2) = 5\). What is \(g(4)\)?

questions.title: Read the growth factor
questions.prompt:
The population of a town \(t\) years after 2020 is modelled by

\[P(t) = 1200(1.04)^t\]

Which statement is true?
choices: The population increases by 4 people each year.
The population increases by 104% each year.
The population increases by 4% each year.
questions.solution: \(1.04 = 1 + 0.04\): each year is 104% of the year before, an increase of **4%**. In 2020, \(t = 0\) and \(P = 1200\).

questions.title: Shift the zeros
questions.prompt:
The graph of \(y = f(x)\) crosses the \(x\)-axis at \(x = -1\) and \(x = 5\).

Where does the graph of \(y = f(x - 3)\) cross the \(x\)-axis?
questions.solution:
\(f(x - 3) = 0\) when \(x - 3 = -1\) or \(x - 3 = 5\):

\[\boxed{x = 2 \text{ and } x = 8}\]

\(-4\) and 2 shift left instead of right.

takeaway: In a·bᵗ the base is the growth factor (1 ± r); a quadratic's vertex form shows its turning point and f(x − h) moves the graph right h.
